name: Raptor Grounds
summary: In the southern Barrens, Sunscale raptors claim the Raptor Grounds, a secluded valley west of Northwatch Hold. Their tool-making cunning and hunger for bright trinkets set them apart from ordinary beasts.

sections.title: Uncanny Beasts of the Southern Wastes
sections.body: West of Northwatch Hold, Sunscale raptors make their home in the Raptor Grounds. They build crude shelters and fashion primitive tools. They hunt together with uncanny skill, far beyond ordinary beasts. Their hunger for shiny or unusual things sends them against passing caravans and Horde encampments. Coins, trinkets, and supplies vanish into their canyon dens.

faq.answer: The Raptor Grounds is a small, sunken valley in the southern Barrens, among rocky hills west of Northwatch Hold.

faq.q: Why are the raptors here different from normal beasts?
faq.answer: Sunscale raptors show an unnatural degree of intelligence. They make primitive tools and crude huts to shelter their pack and hide stolen goods.

faq.q: Why do the raptors attack caravans and steal items?
faq.answer: Sunscale raptors obsess over shiny, glittering, or unusual objects. That fascination drives them to ambush travelers and raid Horde settlements, then hoard stolen coin and metal deep in their valley.
Neither faction holds the valley. It remains the wild Sunscale raptors' hunting and nesting ground, and they fiercely defend it against intruders.

angles.text: Sunscale raptors threaten Horde caravans and outposts across the southern Barrens. Bounties and expeditions seek to recover the stolen wealth.
As a Hunter, you may find the Sunscale pack's unusual cunning, coordinated hunts, and simple shelters fascinating to study as a tracker.
